thesis: The most valuable conversion mechanism on this site is the coverage-check funnel, which is bleeding value due to competing CTAs and ambiguous button labels that dilute the primary action and create choice overload.

findings.title: Duplicate how-it-works headings confuse path
findings.summary: Repeated 'How It Works' headings create identical-looking entry points, confusing the user's path.
findings.problem: Repeated 'How It Works' headings create identical-looking entry points, confusing the user's path.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “How It Works”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Competing CTAs split focus
findings.summary: Multiple CTAs with no hierarchy create choice overload and dilute the primary conversion path.
findings.problem: Multiple CTAs with no hierarchy create choice overload and dilute the primary conversion path.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Single primary CTA: CHECK MY COVERAGE; notes: Secondary actions as subtle links.
findings.evidence: CHECK COVERAGE | CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS | SEE MY OPTIONS | GET STARTED | START CHAT | SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR | CHECK MY COVERAGE | 7 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “CHECK IF IT WORKS AT MY ADDRESS”, “SEE MY OPTIONS”, “GET STARTED”, “START CHAT”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Duplicate forms create dead ends
findings.summary: Multiple identical CONTINUE forms on the same page create ambiguity about which form advances the funnel and risk duplicate submissions.
findings.problem: Multiple identical CONTINUE forms on the same page create ambiguity about which form advances the funnel and risk duplicate submissions.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Single CONTINUE form; notes: Only one submission path per view.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Ambiguous CONTINUE button labels
findings.summary: The submit button labeled only CONTINUE fails to communicate the next step, increasing cognitive effort at the interaction point.
findings.problem: The submit button labeled only CONTINUE fails to communicate the next step, increasing cognitive effort at the interaction point.
findings.recommended_change: cta: Check My Coverage; notes: Descriptive action label.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Pricing shown before qualification
findings.summary: Displaying prices before coverage confirmation creates premature commitment barriers and confusion about applicable plans.
findings.problem: Displaying prices before coverage confirmation creates premature commitment barriers and confusion about applicable plans.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Sequence qualification before pricing or label as examples.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Price inconsistencies across pages
findings.summary: Inconsistent price formatting and values across pages undermine trust in quoted costs.
findings.problem: Inconsistent price formatting and values across pages undermine trust in quoted costs.
findings.evidence: Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/Mo $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95 | Prices shown on the page: $99.95/month $129.95/month $99.95/mo $0.00 $99.95 $99.99
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Coverage claims lack verification detail
findings.summary: Unsubstantiated coverage claims without a visible coverage map or verification explanation undermine trust in the coverage-check funnel.
findings.problem: Unsubstantiated coverage claims without a visible coverage map or verification explanation undermine trust in the coverage-check funnel.
findings.recommended_change: cta: CHECK MY COVERAGE; notes: Add coverage map and explanation of verification.
findings.evidence: A section heading reads “You qualify for everything”. | A section heading reads “Join America's Largest Wireless Internet Provider Featuring”. | 3 distinct calls to action compete on the same page: “CHECK COVERAGE”, “SEE WHAT I QUALIFY FOR”, “CHECK MY COVERAGE”.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
